source_issues.title: [BUG]: Unable to create evaluator with together_ai as AI provider
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告在 self-hosted 环境 v13.15.0 下，使用 together_ai 作为 AI provider 创建 evaluator 时报错，有截图证据，bug 标签确认。

signals.topic: TypeScript client 中 trace ID 无法传递到 evaluators 和 trajectories 流程
signals.summary: 多个 issue (#12329, #12385) 反映 TypeScript client 在 trajectories 流程中无法将 traceID 传递给 evaluators，导致评估链路断裂。
aliases: traceID not passed to evaluators typescript
signals.review_reason: 两条 issue 均明确指向 TypeScript client 在 trajectories/evaluation 流程中 trace ID 传递链断裂的问题，虽无 bug 标签但属核心 tracing 功能缺陷，与 PP-002（global tracer bug）同属 tracing 数据流问题，可能共同导致评估结果不准确。count=2 满足阈值，标记为 P1。

source_issues.title: [trajectories][typescript] plumb through traceID to the evaluators
source_issues.evidence: c/evals 标签，明确需要将 traceID 传递给 evaluators，标注为 trajectory 流程中的关键环节。

source_issues.title: [trajectories] pass through trace ID to typescript client
source_issues.evidence: 同为 trajectories 功能中的 trace ID 传递问题，与 #12329 同属一类根因但角度不同（#12329 面向 evaluators，#12285 面向 typescript client）。

signals.topic: TypeScript client 无法正确挂载/卸载 global tracer，trace 数据写入错误项目
signals.summary: TypeScript client 在运行时会注册一个 global tracer 向 experiment 项目写 trace，评估时需要另一个 tracer，但 global tracer 无法被正确 unmount，导致 trace 数据写入错误项目，数据混淆。
signals.review_reason: 单条 issue 但 bug 标签明确，描述了真实用户场景：global tracer unmount 失败导致 trace 数据写入错误项目，影响实验数据的准确性，虽非高频但影响明确，属于 P1 非阻断但影响明显的问题。

source_issues.title: bug: typescript client for experiments fails to attach / detach the global tracer
source_issues.evidence: bug 标签，描述 global tracer 无法被 unmount，导致 trace 数据写入两个不同项目，数据混淆，属数据正确性问题。

signals.topic: macOS release build pipeline fails due to bash version incompatibility
signals.summary: CI release workflow on macOS runners fails with 'bad substitution' error because `${var,,}` bash 4+ syntax is not supported on bash 3.2 that ships with macOS. This blocks macOS release artifact uploads entirely.
signals.review_reason: CI发布流水线在macOS上完全阻断，release artifacts无法上传，是明确的发布流程失败。虽仅1条issue，但有完整CI run证据和明确的root cause，属于release阻断性问题。

source_issues.title: fix: macOS PyInstaller release CI fails with `bad substitution` on bash 3.2
source_issues.evidence: CI workflow run 23438873188 fails at 'Upload to GitHub release' step: `/bin/bash: line 4: ${OS_SUFFIX,,}: bad substitution`. The ${var,,} lowercase conversion syntax is bash 4+ only, macOS ships bash 3.2. Fix is POSIX-compatible tr replacement.

signals.topic: DuckDuckGo search bot detection causes wasted LLM steps and cost
signals.summary: The search() function defaults to DuckDuckGo, which fails with bot detection errors. Agents waste an LLM step retrying with Perplexity after DDG fails, incurring extra cost and round-trips.
aliases: search backend fails causing wasted steps
signals.review_reason: 搜索是gptme核心功能，DDG被bot detection阻断导致每次搜索多走一个失败+重试流程，直接增加用户LLM调用成本和等待时间。虽count=1但影响明确且高频可复现（任何使用搜索的场景）。

source_issues.title: fix: auto-select search backend with fallbacks, hide unavailable engines
source_issues.evidence: search('query', 'duckduckgo') fails with 'duckduckgo search is disabled due to bot detection'. Agent then has to manually retry with perplexity, costing an extra LLM step. Current behavior forces DDG default regardless of config.

signals.topic: MCP tool descriptions exceed 1024 char LLM limit causing truncation
signals.summary: When using --tool-format tool, MCP tool descriptions exceed the 1024 character limit, triggering truncation warnings. This can degrade tool description quality and cause unpredictable LLM behavior.
signals.review_reason: 工具描述被截断会影响LLM对工具的理解和使用，可能导致工具调用错误或不可预测行为。有明确的WARNING日志和具体的1024限制数字，但影响范围取决于MCP工具数量，非所有场景触发。

source_issues.title: Seeing lots of 'Description for tool is too long'
source_issues.evidence: WARNING: Description for tool `mcp` is too long (1155 > 1024 chars). Truncating... Occurs when using --tool-format tool. Author explicitly requests tests to prevent descriptions exceeding 1024 chars.

signals.topic: V0 conversation metadata.json文件写入时追加重复字符导致JSONDecodeError，agent被卡住不可用
signals.summary: OpenHands 1.5.0升级后，v0对话的metadata.json文件在写入时会在末尾追加重复字符片段，导致JSONDecodeError: Extra data，进而触发HTTP 500错误，agent停留在awaiting_user_input状态无法继续。用户无法正常继续已有对话，主流程被阻断。
signals.review_reason: 明确的用户可感知阻断：v0对话加载时返回500错误，agent被卡住无法继续，主流程完全失败。有完整堆栈和错误日志证据，属于关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: V0 conversations have additional trailing characters in metadata.json
source_issues.evidence: metadata.json contains duplicated trailing JSON fragments causing json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data. HTTP 500 returned on GET /api/conversations/{id}. Agent stuck in awaiting_user_input state. Full stack trace provided.

signals.topic: 自托管V1环境中对话达到READY状态并完成首次LLM调用后，runtime不再产出任何assistant/action/observation事件，agent陷入RUNNING假死
signals.summary: 在自托管V1部署中，对话到达READY状态、sandbox启动正常、仓库准备完成、首次LLM调用成功，但之后runtime不再产出任何后续事件（无assistant事件、无tool调用事件、无observation），对话永久停留在RUNNING状态。provider和sandbox均正常，agent实质上不可用。
aliases: first LLM success but no events
signals.review_reason: 明确的用户可感知阻断：自托管V1 agent在所有基础设施正常的情况下假死，无法产出任何后续事件，主流程完全不可用。报告者明确标注为'makes the self-hosted agent effectively unusable'，属于关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: conversation reaches READY and first LLM completion succeeds, but no assistant or action events are persisted
source_issues.evidence: Conversation stays in RUNNING, only early startup events + user message present, no assistant/action/observation events follow after successful first LLM completion. Provider and sandbox confirmed healthy. Reporter explicitly states: 'This makes the self-hosted agent effectively unusable.'

signals.topic: 自托管V1环境中，用户设置和provider token在重启后状态残缺，系统进入半损坏状态需手动恢复
signals.summary: 自托管V1部署中，重启或重载后，之前保存的设置无法可靠加载，provider token状态出现残缺，GitHub集成失效，系统需要通过API或手动操作重新恢复状态才能继续工作。自托管用户遭遇反复的手动恢复工作，系统持久化可靠性低下。
signals.review_reason: 明确的自托管用户体验损失：重启后设置和token状态残缺，导致系统进入半损坏状态需手动恢复，自托管可操作性严重下降。虽然只有1个报告，但review_reason明确给出强用户影响证据（serious operability issue + repeated manual recovery），满足P0条件。

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: user settings and provider token state appear fragile across restart
source_issues.evidence: Backend responds as if settings are missing after restart. Startup fails on missing-settings assertion path. Provider token context needs re-hydration to recover repository access. Reporter explicitly labels this: 'This is a serious operability issue for self-hosted setups.'

signals.topic: V1架构下WebSocket需要浏览器直连sandbox端点，默认暴露为localhost导致所有自托管部署无法正常工作
signals.summary: V1架构中，WebSocket连接改为由浏览器直接连向每个sandbox的端点（默认http://localhost:port），这对自托管部署是致命问题：localhost端口在容器外部无法访问、需要动态配置防火墙和反向代理、ISP可能封禁非标准端口。所有自托管用户无法正常使用WebSocket通信通道，sandbox交互完全阻断。
signals.review_reason: 明确的用户可感知阻断：V1 WebSocket架构要求直连sandbox端点，默认localhost暴露，所有自托管用户完全无法使用sandbox交互通道，属于主流程阻断。count=1且无强多源证据，默认不适用P0，标记P1。

source_issues.title: Reintroduce single endpoint for handling all WebSocket connections across sandboxes
source_issues.evidence: V1 requires direct browser-to-sandbox WebSocket connections at non-standard localhost ports. Self-hosted deployments cannot work because localhost is not accessible from outside containers. Requires dynamic firewall/proxy rules. All self-hosted users affected.

signals.topic: 自托管V1环境中仓库被克隆到workspace子目录，而后续setup和hook逻辑在workspace根目录查找文件，导致setup脚本和hook发现失败
signals.summary: 自托管V1中，GitHub仓库被克隆到workspace的子目录（如/workspace/project/<repo-name>），但后续setup/hook解析逻辑在workspace根目录（/workspace/project）查找.openhands/setup.sh等文件，导致setup脚本执行失败、hook发现失败、git命令cwd不一致。
aliases: repo cloned to subdirectory setup broken
signals.review_reason: 明确的自托管用户主流程阻断：仓库路径和setup/hook路径不匹配，导致setup脚本和hook发现全部失败，agent初始化流程不完整。count=1且为自托管特定问题，标记P1。

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: repository is cloned into a subdirectory while setup and hook logic assume repo root at workspace root
source_issues.evidence: Repo cloned into workspace/<repo-name> but setup logic looks for .openhands/setup.sh at workspace root. Hook discovery fails. git cwd inconsistent. Reporter has local hotfix (git clone <repo> . instead of git clone <repo> <dir_name>) that fixes it.

signals.topic: Broken self-hosting documentation links block new users from setup
signals.summary: The official self-hosting setup guide link redirects to a dead/error page (agpt.co/docs/platform/getting-started), preventing users from following onboarding documentation.
signals.review_reason: This is a real user pain point: a broken documentation link actively blocks new users from completing self-hosting setup. Evidence is direct from a user who attempted to follow the official guide and hit a dead URL.

source_issues.title: invalid proxy url for site when getting self-hosting setup guide
source_issues.evidence: User clicks official self-hosting guide link, gets error page. On Linux/Azure/Latest Release. Direct link to docs returns error.

signals.topic: Agent run fails with 'openai_api_key_credentials' required input error despite user configuring it
signals.summary: Users who correctly set their API key in .env and have credits still receive a 'Not all required inputs are set' error requiring 'openai_api_key_credentials', preventing the agent from running at all.
aliases: agent run blocked by credential error
setup completes but agent won't start
signals.review_reason: This is a primary flow blocker: a user completes all setup steps correctly (docker, .env, API key, credits) but the agent fails to run with a credential input error. Despite clear evidence the user did everything right, the app demands 'openai_api_key_credentials' again. This blocks the core use case entirely.

source_issues.title: Error on agent run: Not all required inputs are set Please set 'openai_api_key_credentials'
source_issues.evidence: User installed correctly via docker, copied .env, input openai api key credentials, funded account with $5, built agent per video tutorial — still gets blocking error at runtime.

signals.topic: Cloudflare blocks AutoGPT agents from accessing major websites during web research
signals.summary: AutoGPT agents performing web research hit Cloudflare 403 blocks or get empty content when accessing major news outlets, LinkedIn, Amazon, and government pages, making web research tasks fail or return unusable results.
signals.review_reason: Web research is a core use case for AutoGPT agents. When major websites (news, LinkedIn, Amazon, government) return 403 or empty content due to Cloudflare protection, agents cannot complete research tasks. While the issue is framed as a feature/tool suggestion, the underlying problem (Cloudflare blocking agent web access) is a genuine, described user pain affecting the primary workflow.

source_issues.title: Tool: anybrowse for Cloudflare-bypass web browsing in AutoGPT agents
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly states: 'AutoGPT agents doing web research frequently hit Cloudflare-protected sites -- most major news outlets, LinkedIn, Amazon, government pages return 403 or empty content.' Suggests third-party bypass tool as mitigation.

signals.topic: Agent Outputs panel only shows last output, hiding intermediate results during agent runs
signals.summary: The Agent Outputs panel in the UI only displays the final output, discarding all intermediate outputs generated during a single agent run, reducing visibility into agent reasoning and progress.
signals.review_reason: This is a UX issue that degrades the agent monitoring experience: users cannot see the chain of intermediate outputs during a run, making it harder to understand agent reasoning and debug issues. It is labeled a bug by maintainers.

source_issues.title: Only The Last Output Shows in "Agent Outputs" Panel
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly states: 'The Agent Outputs panel currently only shows the final output for Agents that output several times during a single run. This panel should instead show all the outputs of that run.' Confirmed as a bug by project maintainers (labeled 'good first issue').

signals.topic: Agent工具调用陷入无限循环/死循环（反复调用同一工具或记忆组件触发）
signals.summary: Agent在执行过程中反复调用同一工具，无法自动停止；长期记忆组件(reme)导致死循环，程序无法退出。
signals.review_reason: 两个issue均体现主流程被彻底阻断：工具调用无限循环导致agent无法正常完成单次任务，长期记忆死循环导致程序无法退出，属于高频（反复重复）+ 阻断性极强的核心问题。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:React agent陷入反复工具调用
source_issues.evidence: Agent在工具已成功执行后仍反复调用同一工具，即使工具返回值中明确告知'已调用成功，不要再调用'，仍继续调用。用户被迫手动终止程序。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:使用reme长期记忆，陷入死循环
source_issues.evidence: 使用qwen3-max运行长期记忆程序，程序反复重复回答同一问题长达141秒以上，用户不得不手动强制终止，否则永不停歇。

signals.topic: qwen3模型非流式输出+思考模式组合下输出解析异常/损坏
signals.summary: qwen3模型在非流式输出配合思考模式开启或关闭时，返回的JSON结构解析异常，思考内容被错误塞入tool_call字段，导致关键功能不可用。
signals.review_reason: 两个issue共同指向qwen3模型在非流式+思考模式下的解析根因，导致思考内容被错误解析为工具调用，属于关键功能不可用，count=2但影响明确，应为P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:qwen3 vllm非流式输出下解析bug
source_issues.evidence: qwen3模型使用vllm部署，非流式输出配合思考开启/关闭时，reasoning-parser解析异常，模型返回的thinking内容被错误解析为tool_call格式，导致功能不可用。

source_issues.title: 流式和非流式与思考模式组合的问题
source_issues.evidence: 非流式输出配合思考模式时，assistant返回的content中thinking内容被错误塞入tool_call块，而非作为正常思考内容输出。

signals.topic: 消息内容包含`</tool_call>`标签时解析卡死，任务无法继续
signals.summary: 当模型输出或工具返回内容中包含`</tool_call>`字符串时，框架解析陷入卡死，后续无任何输出，任务被永久阻断。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断问题：任何包含</tool_call>的输出都会导致任务卡死，在真实使用中（数据库工具返回SQL结果、shell工具输出等）极易触发，属于关键路径上的解析缺陷。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:消息遇到</tool_call>任务会卡主
source_issues.evidence: 工具返回结果中出现</tool_call>标签后，agent输出完全卡住，不再有任何后续输出，任务永久阻断。

signals.topic: 阿里云DashScope兼容OpenAI接口使用json_object格式调用工具时API报错400
signals.summary: 使用阿里云dashscope兼容接口时，若启用json_object格式，API返回400错误提示messages必须包含'json'字样，工具调用完全失败，用户只能通过清除消息才能恢复。
aliases: 阿里云兼容接口工具调用失败
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：工具调用是ReActAgent的核心能力，API返回400直接导致工具调用失败，且需手动清除消息才能恢复，属于关键功能不可用+明显成本损失（token浪费）。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:我使用阿里兼容的openai接口调用工具报错
source_issues.evidence: 使用阿里云dashscope API在工具调用超出次数时报错400，之后只能清除消息才能恢复。错误原因：阿里云API要求messages中包含'json'字样才能使用json_object格式，但框架未做兼容处理。

signals.topic: qwen3.5模型配合vLLM部署时chat template错误导致Agent无法正常工作
signals.summary: 使用qwen3.5模型通过vLLM部署时，框架传递的消息格式触发transformers的chat template错误，进而导致OpenAI BadRequestError，agent无法响应用户。
signals.review_reason: 核心功能阻断：使用主流模型qwen3.5的用户无法正常启动agent，框架与模型部署的不兼容直接导致agent流程完全失败。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Agentscope can not use qwen3.5 model
source_issues.evidence: qwen3.5模型通过vLLM部署后，agentscope调用时触发transformers的chat template错误和OpenAI BadRequestError，agent完全无法返回响应，模型不可用。

signals.topic: CustomEvent dynamic attributes silently lost during session serialization via RunOutput.to_dict()
signals.summary: Fields set via setattr on CustomEvent instances are dropped when RunOutput.to_dict() uses dataclasses.asdict(), causing custom tool event data to be permanently lost on session reload
signals.review_reason: Session state corruption: custom tool events stream correctly but ALL dynamic fields are permanently lost on session reload. Affects any workflow relying on session persistence (e.g., agent memory, resume, replay). Impact is clear and reproducible.

source_issues.title: [Bug] CustomEvent dynamic attributes lost during session serialization (asdict drops setattr fields)
source_issues.evidence: CustomEvent fields set via setattr are silently dropped when RunOutput.to_dict() serializes events. Custom events stream correctly but ALL custom fields are lost on session reload.

source_issues.title: CustomEvent dynamic attributes lost during session serialization (asdict)
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate of #7075, confirmed same root cause: dataclasses.asdict() only serializes declared fields, not dynamically set instance attributes.

signals.topic: CodingTools command allowlist bypassed by interpreter inline flags (python -c, node -e, etc.) enabling RCE
signals.summary: _check_command skips all flag tokens starting with '-' without inspecting what follows, allowing allowlisted binaries combined with inline-execution flags to execute arbitrary code
signals.review_reason: Critical severity RCE vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) allowing arbitrary code execution through the CodingTools' shell command execution path. Since run_shell accepts LLM output as input, any malicious model output or prompt injection can trigger it. Users of CodingTools are directly impacted.

source_issues.title: [Security] CodingTools: RCE via interpreter flag injection in _check_command (allowlist bypass)
source_issues.evidence: CVSS 9.8 Critical. An attacker can combine allowlisted 'python' with skipped flag '-c' to execute arbitrary code. Affects agno v2.5.1-v2.5.10. Since run_shell takes LLM output, the attacker can be the LLM model itself or a prompt injection.

signals.topic: run_shell command allowlist bypassed via embedded newline characters
signals.summary: _check_command blocks shell operators (&&, ||, ;, |) but does not sanitize newline characters, which start a new command in shell=True mode, bypassing all checks
signals.review_reason: Command injection vulnerability allowing arbitrary shell command execution through newline character bypass. Since run_shell processes LLM-generated output, prompt injection or model misbehavior can lead to destructive commands being executed on the host system.

source_issues.title: run_shell _check_command can be bypassed with newline in command
source_issues.evidence: Passing 'ls\nrm -rf /' bypasses all command checks since newlines start a new shell command. Since run_shell takes LLM output, model-generated commands with embedded newlines can trigger this.

signals.topic: Skills become non-functional when output_schema is enabled on Agent
signals.summary: Enabling output_schema on an Agent that also loads Skills causes Skills to silently stop working, with no error messages
aliases: Skills disabled when output_schema is active
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking: when a user enables structured output (output_schema) with skills, skills silently stop working with no error messages. This blocks the combined use case of structured output + skills, which is a legitimate and common pattern.

source_issues.title: 当加载 skill 的时候同时启用output_schema时， skill失效
source_issues.evidence: Skills=Skills(loaders=[LocalSkills(...)]) with output_schema=TaskList causes skills to silently fail. Removing output_schema restores skill functionality. No error is raised, making this a silent failure.

signals.topic: OpenAILike cache_response=True raises TypeError: ModelMetaclass is not JSON serializable during followup generation
signals.summary: When using OpenAILike model with cache_response=True and followups enabled, _get_model_cache_key returns a non-JSON-serializable ModelMetaclass object, causing TypeError and blocking the followup workflow
signals.review_reason: Runtime crash when using OpenAILike's caching feature with followups. The TypeError blocks the entire followup generation path, making the caching feature unusable in combination with followups.

source_issues.title: [Bug] OpenAILike: cache_response=True causes TypeError: Object of type ModelMetaclass is not JSON serializable
source_issues.evidence: TypeError raised during followup generation when cache_response=True on OpenAILike. The cache_key contains a ModelMetaclass object which is not JSON serializable. Blocks the caching + followup workflow.

signals.topic: OpenCode Desktop 1.3.0 broke Anthropic Pro/Max login: subscription users cannot authenticate
signals.summary: Since upgrading to OpenCode Desktop 1.3.0, users with Anthropic Pro/Max subscriptions can no longer log in. The 'Connect provider' interface only prompts for an API key, which Anthropic does not support for these subscription tiers, completely blocking access to the service for paying users.
aliases: Connect provider missing OAuth for Anthropic Pro/Max
Cannot login with Claude subscription after update
signals.review_reason: Two separate users (jcubic, wkgardner) independently report being unable to authenticate with Anthropic Pro/Max subscriptions after the 1.3.0 update. This is a clear P0: it blocks paying subscribers from using the core product, directly causes financial harm (forced to switch to pay-per-token), and has confirmed user impact with screenshots. Count=2 meets the threshold with strong user evidence.

source_issues.title: Update to OpenCode Desktop Version 1.3.0 broke Anthropic Pro/Max login method auth
source_issues.evidence: User reports connecting Claude Max account via 'Connect provider' interface is broken — only API key prompt shown, no OAuth/subscription login method. Screenshots attached showing dropdown missing subscription option for Anthropic while OpenAI still has multiple login methods.

source_issues.title: How to login to Claude Max?
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states they cannot use OpenCode with Claude subscription and are forced to use API key, paying per token instead of using their existing subscription.

signals.topic: GitLab Duo Workflow: system prompt conflict and plan mode injected as user message
signals.summary: When using duo-workflow models, OpenCode's system prompt conflicts with GitLab Duo Workflow's server-side prompt (DWS wins), causing the model to identify as 'GitLab Duo' instead of OpenCode. Additionally, plan mode instructions are injected as user message text rather than system instructions, cluttering conversation history and confusing the model.
aliases: Duo workflow system prompt override broken
Plan mode leaked as user message
signals.review_reason: Two issues from the same author describing a GitLab Duo integration gap. The identity conflict and plan mode injection degrade the model response quality and clutter conversation history. Both are real UX issues but affect a specific integration (GitLab Duo) rather than the core app. P2 due to narrow scope (Duo Workflow-specific) and same author (potential duplicate perspective).

source_issues.title: GitLab Duo Workflow models receive conflicting system prompts and plan mode leaks as user message
source_issues.evidence: Author provides detailed technical analysis with concrete DWS startRequest WebSocket API fix (flowConfig.prompt_template.system, additional_context). Confirms model identity conflict: asking 'who are you?' returns 'I am GitLab Duo' ignoring OpenCode system prompt.

source_issues.title: Missing tools for Gitlab Duo Workflow in OpenCode
source_issues.evidence: Author reports critical tools missing from Duo Workflow (Task, TodoWrite, Webfetch, MCPs, Skills) that exist in OpenCode's system prompt, causing capability gap. Author references their own working plugin implementation proving the fix is feasible.

signals.topic: Desktop app crashes on NixOS after sending first prompt — missing shared library
signals.summary: OpenCode desktop app crashes immediately after sending the first prompt on NixOS, caused by a missing shared library (libstdc++.so.6) and GStreamer elements. The app is unusable for NixOS users.
signals.review_reason: Crash is reproducible (sending a prompt always triggers it) and leaves the app completely unusable. While count=1, the crash is severe and well-evidenced with full stack traces. Review_reason provides explicit user impact evidence: 'app crashes' after every prompt, confirmed with error logs. Platform-specific but affects a real user on NixOS 26.05.

source_issues.title: Desktop app crashes on nixos
source_issues.evidence: User provides full crash log showing: 'libstdc++.so.6: cannot open shared object file' — app launches and prompt goes through but then crashes immediately. Multiple MCP services also fail (web-search, fetch, sequential-thinking). GStreamer critical errors in WebKitWebProcess.

signals.topic: Session chat disappears mid-conversation — session state lost silently
signals.summary: Users report that active chat sessions silently disappear after a few minutes, leaving only a blank 'New Task' screen. The session is neither in the chat nor in session history, indicating silent data loss that blocks ongoing work.
signals.review_reason: Session disappearance causes direct data loss — the user's ongoing work is gone with no recovery path. This is a session state bug, not a feature request. The evidence is clear: user describes exact repro path and result (blank screen, nothing in history). While single-occurrence, the severity (data loss, reproducibility) justifies P1.

source_issues.title: Session chat disappears.
source_issues.evidence: User reports opening VS Code extension, sending a prompt, and returning 3-5 minutes later to find the entire session gone — not in chat history, not in session list. Work is silently lost with no recovery path. Reproducible but non-deterministic.

signals.topic: Permission required dialog box has no scroll — users cannot accept permissions to proceed
signals.summary: The 'permission required' dialog box does not scroll, preventing users from viewing and accepting the permission request. This blocks the user from proceeding with their task until the dialog is resolved.
signals.review_reason: This is a UI interaction bug that directly blocks the user's workflow. The user cannot accept the permission request because the dialog is non-scrollable, preventing them from seeing or interacting with the necessary controls. Count=1 but review_reason provides explicit blocking evidence.

source_issues.title: No scroll in permission required box
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states they 'cannot scroll down in box prompting permission required, so cannot accept request.' This is a direct workflow blocker — the user cannot proceed until they accept a permission that they cannot see or interact with.

signals.topic: Web search streaming 输出提取逻辑错误：取最后一个文本块而非真实内容块，导致主流程阻断与额外计费
signals.summary: Streaming 流式响应中，当 Claude 使用 web search 工具时，输出包含多个 text block（研究旁白 + 最终正文）。SDK 代码取最后一个 text block 作为最终内容，但旁白文本（如「Now let me verify...」）通常比正文短，导致内容丢失；同时 Opus 进行大量 web search 产生 2.3M 输入 tokens，产生 $36/chapter 的异常费用。用户被迫自己 hack 流式提取逻辑（取最长块或含 markdown 标题的块）作为 workaround，说明 API/SDK 在工具使用场景下对输出结构的处理存在根本性设计缺陷。
aliases: streaming output extraction broken for web search tool use
text block selection logic incorrect in streaming with tools
web search tool output interleaving not handled by SDK
signals.review_reason: Streaming 流中 web search 工具的输出混入了旁白 text block，SDK 取最后一个 block 导致内容丢失和 $36/chapter 的异常计费，用户的报告生成主流程被阻断。问题已通过真实 API 调用确认，issue 中提供了代码层面的根因分析和 workaround，体现出 API/SDK 在工具流场景下输出结构处理的设计缺陷。

source_issues.title: API does not cleanly separate tool-use mechanics (search queries, results, narration) from the final authored content
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告 $36/chapter 的异常计费（2.3M 输入 tokens），原因是 streaming handler 错误地取最后一个 text block（旁白）而非正文；内容提取失败导致主流程阻断；issue 中用户被迫自行修复 generate_county_report.py 中的提取逻辑。

signals.topic: 非 beta 路径 streaming tool use 吐出原始 jiter 解析错误，无用户友好的错误信息
signals.summary: 使用 client.messages.stream() 配合 tools 时，若模型输出格式错误的 JSON（非 beta 路径 _messages.py 的 accumulate_event），用户直接看到 ValueError: "expected ident at line 1 column 11"，无任何上下文——不知道是 tool 参数 JSON 解析失败、接收到了什么 JSON、也无修复指引。Beta 路径 (_beta_messages.py) 已有 try-except 包装，但非 beta 路径缺失，导致所有非 beta 用户遇到此场景时 SDK 表现为崩溃。
aliases: streaming tool use malformed JSON gives raw error
non-beta streaming accumulate_event missing error handling
signals.review_reason: Streaming 流中模型输出畸形 JSON 时，非 beta 路径将原始 jiter 异常直接暴露给用户，无任何错误上下文或操作指引，使 SDK 看起来像崩溃了一样。所有 streaming + tools 用户均受影响，已通过真实 API 调用确认，问题路径清晰（_messages.py 缺少 try-except），属于用户体验显著下降且主流程有阻断风险的痛点。

source_issues.title: Streaming tool use: unhelpful error message when model emits malformed JSON (non-beta path missing try-except)
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了完整的复现代码，展示非 beta 路径直接抛出 ValueError 无任何额外信息；已确认 beta 路径有 try-except 但非 beta 路径缺失；Every user of client.messages.stream() with tool calling is affected；issue 附有真实 API 调用验证。

signals.topic: SSE stream 中间错误事件报告 status_code=200 而非真实错误码，导致下游重试逻辑失效
signals.summary: 当 API 返回 HTTP 200（streaming 启动成功）但后续发送 SSE 错误事件（如 overloaded_error）时，SDK 调用 _make_status_error 传入原始 HTTP 200 响应对象，导致错误子类判断失效——overloaded_error 变成 status_code=200 的 APIStatusError 而非 OverloadedError。下游库（如 pydantic-ai FallbackModel）依赖 status_code 判断是否触发重试/fallback，因状态码错误（200 而非 529）导致 fallback 从不触发，生产环境策略降级失效。
aliases: SSE error event wrong status code
mid-stream SSE errors not mapped to correct HTTP status
streaming error dispatch broken for SSE error events
signals.review_reason: SSE streaming 中间错误状态码错误（200 而非实际错误码）导致下游依赖 status_code 的重试/降级策略完全失效，生产中已造成 pydantic-ai FallbackModel 策略降级失败，属于主流程失败且有明确生产影响证据的痛点。错误代码路径已精确到 _streaming.py 的 SSE error 事件处理，issue 提供了完整的根因分析和修复方案。

source_issues.title: Mid-stream SSE errors get `status_code=200` instead of the actual error code
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了具体代码路径（_streaming.py ~line 229 和 _client.py _make_status_error）；确认 pydantic-ai 的 FallbackModel 依赖 status_code>=500 判断触发 next model，生产中因此不触发 fallback；_SSE_ERROR_TYPE_TO_STATUS 映射方案已在 issue 中提出；使用 claude-sonnet-4-20250514 streaming API 确认。

signals.topic: Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6 models make only 1 parallel tool call in Batch API instead of all tools (regression from 4.5)
signals.summary: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 with Message Batches API produce only 1 tool call per response even when 46 tools are provided with sufficient max_tokens (64K+), whereas Opus 4.5 correctly calls 39+ tools in parallel. This is a production-blocking regression for multi-tool extraction pipelines.
aliases: tool_choice any not producing parallel calls on 4.6
signals.review_reason: This is a production-blocking regression: Claude 4.6 models make only 1 tool call instead of all parallel tools in Batch API, breaking multi-tool extraction pipelines. The user explicitly states patient medical records are incomplete and they had to downgrade to Opus 4.5 as a workaround. The evidence is concrete: same request, same tools, same document — Opus 4.5 calls 39+ tools, Opus 4.6 calls 1. Main workflow is fully blocked.

source_issues.title: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 fail to make parallel tool calls in Batch API
source_issues.evidence: Opus 4.6 calls exactly 1 tool with 64K tokens vs Opus 4.5 calling 39+ with same request; stop_reason is 'tool_use' after first call, blocking full medical document extraction pipeline with 46 tools. Production-blocking regression, no workaround except downgrading to Opus 4.5.

signals.topic: toBase64 utility crashes with stack overflow on large inputs (>~100KB) in non-Node environments (browser, Cloudflare Workers)
signals.summary: The toBase64 utility in the SDK crashes with 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' on large inputs like image uploads in standard browsers and Cloudflare Workers, where Node.js Buffer is unavailable.
signals.review_reason: The toBase64 utility crashes with a RangeError on inputs >100KB in non-Node environments, directly blocking image upload workflows in browsers and Cloudflare Workers. This is a clear runtime failure causing workflow breakdown for a legitimate SDK use case (encoding large images for API requests). The crash is reproducible and not edge-case dependent.

source_issues.title: toBase64 stack overflow on large inputs (e.g. image uploads) in non-Node environments
source_issues.evidence: Crashes with RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded when processing Uint8Array inputs >100KB in browser/worker environments without Node.js Buffer. This blocks image upload use cases end-to-end.

signals.topic: SDK unusable from Claude Code hooks/plugins due to CLAUDECODE=1 env var inheritance
signals.summary: The subprocess transport inherits CLAUDECODE=1 from parent Claude Code sessions, causing the CLI to reject startup with 'Claude Code cannot be launched inside another Claude Code session.' This completely blocks the primary advertised use case — building Claude Code hooks and plugins with the SDK.
aliases: CLAUDECODE env var leaks into subprocess
SDK cannot run inside Claude Code session
nested session rejection blocks hook/plugin SDK usage
signals.review_reason: Issue #573 is a direct blocker: the SDK's primary documented use case (building Claude Code hooks/plugins) is completely unusable because the subprocess inherits CLAUDECODE=1 and the CLI refuses to start. Issue #701 independently confirms the same env-var inheritance pattern — skill_improvement_apply (an internal Claude Code hook) fires during headless SDK calls. Together they show a systemic env-isolation failure causing the core product to be unusable in its intended context.

source_issues.title: Bug: Subprocess inherits CLAUDECODE=1 env var, preventing SDK usage from Claude Code hooks/plugins
source_issues.evidence: Root cause confirmed in subprocess_cli.py: process_env spreads os.environ without filtering CLAUDECODE. Reproduction script shows CLI stderr: 'Error: Claude Code cannot be launched inside another Claude Code session.' Only workaround is manually passing CLAUDECODE='' via env option.

source_issues.title: Agent SDK CLI hangs indefinitely during synthesis after successful tool calls
source_issues.evidence: SDK CLI hangs after tool calls complete with zero tokens emitted. skill_improvement_apply hook fires during headless SDK query, an internal feature that should be disabled for SDK invocations. Blocks the primary agent workflow with no recovery.

signals.topic: Session isolation failure — context leaks across session IDs in single long-lived client
signals.summary: When using one long-lived ClaudeSDKClient with different session_id values, conversations are not isolated. session_B reads secrets written in session_A. The ResultMessage returns the same session_id for all requests regardless of the requested session_id.
signals.review_reason: Issue #560 is a confirmed security/correctness failure: the SDK's isolated_sessions feature does not work — different session IDs produce the same context and session_B reads session_A's secrets. Issue #555 independently confirms session routing is broken: resume silently creates a new session with no error. Together they demonstrate that session isolation — a core SDK guarantee — is fundamentally broken across multiple code paths.

source_issues.title: ClaudeSDKClient session_id does not isolate context in single long-lived client
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed test output: 'a1_sid' and 'b1_sid' return the identical UUID '7d21d722-de79-42cb-a752-a7e4efd45b5a' despite requesting different session IDs. session_B returns secrets from session_A. Uses isolated_sessions=True. Production use case (passive message processing with persistent SDK process) is fundamentally broken.

source_issues.title: Session resume silently creates new session despite valid session file and correct parameters
source_issues.evidence: Resume with valid session_id='61568b3d...' returns a new session_id='220a71ec...' with no error or warning. Session file exists and is valid (21KB, valid JSONL). Silent context loss in Kubernetes/NFS environment. Impact: users lose conversation context with no detection mechanism.

signals.topic: CLI fails to create project log directory in multi-agent environments — ENOENT, lock contention, OOM
signals.summary: When running multiple concurrent agents with slash-containing CWD paths, the CLI fails to create the project log directory ($HOME/.claude/projects/), resulting in ENOENT errors on session files. In parallel runs, lock contention on config files causes repeated errors. Some processes are OOM-killed.
aliases: race condition in session file writes
signals.review_reason: Issue #513 shows the CLI crashes with file errors and OOM kills in multi-agent environments — a core production use case. Issue #584 independently confirms a race condition in session file persistence that breaks resume in programmatic SDK workflows. Both stem from inadequate file-system handling during concurrent/multi-turn usage, which is precisely the multi-agent production scenario the SDK targets.

source_issues.title: Claude Code CLI fails to create project log path; ENOENT + lock contention + OOM in multi-agent environment
source_issues.evidence: CLI attempts to open session file under $HOME/.claude/projects/{normalized_cwd}/{session_id}.jsonl but does not create the intermediate directory. Error: ENOENT. In parallel runs: 'Lock file is already being held' errors. Some processes OOM-killed (exit code -9) after repeated lock/file write attempts.

source_issues.title: Race condition when writing *.jsonl session file
source_issues.evidence: Session file written as stub-only (139 bytes) when client disconnects immediately. Resume fails with 'Command failed with exit code 1'. Reproduction confirms: with async context manager or no sleep before disconnect, session file is never flushed. Requires manual sleep(1) workaround. Blocks programmatic multi-turn conversation workflows.

signals.topic: Agent CLI hangs indefinitely after tool calls — synthesis never starts
signals.summary: The Claude Agent SDK CLI process hangs indefinitely after completing tool calls, emitting zero synthesis tokens. Reproducible across 5+ runs over 3 days. The main agent workflow is blocked — no result is ever returned.
aliases: CLI hangs after tool calls complete
indefinite hang after last tool call
signals.review_reason: This is a main-flow blocker. The agent's entire purpose is to complete tasks by calling tools and synthesizing results. When synthesis never starts, the workflow never completes regardless of how many tools succeed. The issue is reproducible across multiple days and environments, with detailed timing data confirming a 600s timeout pattern consistent with an internal timeout. The only workaround is abandoning the Agent SDK entirely.

source_issues.title: Agent SDK CLI hangs indefinitely during synthesis after successful tool calls
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible across 5+ runs over 3 days. Tool calls stream normally for ~5 minutes with 40-43 successful calls. After last tool result: zero messages, zero StreamEvents. Hook AbortError at 600s (API_TIMEOUT_MS default). Workaround requires bypassing the Agent SDK entirely and using the Messages API directly with a separate API key.

signals.topic: Session resume fails silently — creates new session instead of resuming
signals.summary: When attempting to resume a session with a valid resume parameter and an existing session file, the SDK silently creates a new session. No error or warning is raised. Users lose conversation context without knowing it happened.
aliases: session resume silently creates new session
signals.review_reason: This is a silent data-loss bug. Session resume is a core SDK feature for maintaining conversation context across requests. When it fails silently, users lose all accumulated context without knowing. The severity is compounded because there is no error, no warning, and no way to detect the failure — the SDK acts as if it succeeded. This blocks any workflow relying on persistent session state.

source_issues.title: Session resume silently creates new session despite valid session file and correct parameters
source_issues.evidence: Valid session file (21KB, correct session_id, valid JSONL) exists. Resume with correct resume='61568b3d...' returns new session_id='220a71ec...' with zero error/warning. Impact: users lose conversation context without any detection mechanism. Requires application-level workarounds to compare expected vs actual session IDs.

signals.topic: SDK writes invalid JSONL transcript entries causing 400 API errors on session resume/compact
signals.summary: SDK writes empty text blocks and orphaned tool_result blocks to JSONL session transcripts, triggering 'text content blocks must be non-empty' and 'unexpected tool_use_id' 400 validation errors when sessions are resumed or compacted, blocking long-running agent sessions.
signals.review_reason: 用户主流程被阻断：400 API validation errors prevent session resume/compact, causing request rejection before any processing. Long-running agent sessions become unusable. Clear cost waste (API calls rejected) and requires fragile custom workarounds. 有明确的 400 错误消息、复现路径和级联错误风险。

source_issues.title: SDK writes illegal entries to session JSONL transcripts (empty text blocks + orphaned tool_results)
source_issues.evidence: SDK writes {type: 'text', text: ''} blocks during streaming which the API rejects on resume with 'text content blocks must be non-empty'. After compaction, tool_result blocks become orphaned referencing removed tool_use IDs, causing 'unexpected tool_use_id' 400 errors. Both block long-running agent sessions, waste API calls (rejected before processing), and require consumers to implement custom transcript repair logic. Cascade into consecutive error loops if unhandled.

signals.topic: sandbox.enabled:true silently falls back to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is missing
signals.summary: On Linux, when bubblewrap is not installed, the SDK silently disables sandboxing with no error, no warning, and no indication in the result stream, even when sandbox.enabled:true and allowUnsandboxedCommands:false are explicitly configured.
signals.review_reason: 用户明确配置了安全沙箱（sandbox.enabled:true + allowUnsandboxedCommands:false），但 SDK 完全静默地降级为无沙箱执行，所有文件系统和网络隔离措施被绕过，用户完全不知情。造成虚假的安全感，实际安全控制完全失效，风险极高。有明确复现步骤。

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: checkDependencies() detects bwrap is missing but SDK silently falls through. isSandboxingEnabled() returns false. Bash commands execute with full filesystem/network access despite sandbox.enabled:true, sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite, sandbox.network.allowedDomains configuration. No error thrown, no warning in result stream. allowUnsandboxedCommands:false has no effect since it only applies per-command when sandbox is active.

signals.topic: createSdkMcpServer strips Zod v4 .describe() metadata from tool inputSchema property descriptions
signals.summary: When using Zod v4, field-level .describe() metadata is dropped from MCP tools/list schemas generated by createSdkMcpServer, so property descriptions like 'use English' are not visible to the model.
aliases: Zod v4 describe metadata lost in MCP schemas
MCP tool schema missing field guidance
signals.review_reason: 关键工具属性描述丢失，导致模型无法获得字段级指导，可能引发工具调用错误。Zod v4 是声明的 peerDependency，此兼容性缺口直接影响 MCP 工具的用户体验质量。有可复现代码和版本信息（zod@4.3.6, SDK 0.2.76/0.2.81）。

source_issues.title: createSdkMcpServer drops Zod v4 field .describe() metadata from tool inputSchema
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction with exact code: property descriptions set via .describe('use English') are absent from the generated MCP inputSchema. z.toJSONSchema(z.object(...)) preserves them correctly under Zod v4, indicating the internal conversion path reads from _def.description instead of Zod v4's metadata registry. Model loses field-level guidance that is critical for correct tool invocation.

signals.topic: SDK returns inconsistent and opaque error state on network failure (is_error:false with error_during_execution subtype)
signals.summary: When the network drops during query execution, the SDK returns subtype:'error_during_execution' with is_error:false and an empty errors array, making it impossible to programmatically detect failure and surface meaningful error messages to end users.
aliases: empty errors array on real failure
signals.review_reason: 真实故障场景下错误信息完全不可用：is_error 和 subtype 相互矛盾，errors 数组为空，用户无法判断是否出错、出了什么错。要求用户自行实现变通逻辑才能向其终端用户展示有意义的错误。体验显著下降。

source_issues.title: More descriptive Errors in the SDK
source_issues.evidence: User's wifi failure produces result with subtype:'error_during_execution' but is_error:false and errors:[]. Three-way inconsistency makes programmatic detection impossible. User explicitly states they 'need to show nice errors to users, not generic error_during_execution which is too vague.' Requires custom workaround logic to surface meaningful errors.

signals.topic: getSessionMessages() excludes system and subagent messages needed for full session restoration
signals.summary: getSessionMessages() only returns user/assistant messages but omits system messages (which contain permission mode info) and subagent conversation content, preventing complete session state restoration from disk.
signals.review_reason: 会话恢复场景下关键状态（permission mode、subagent 对话）丢失，影响需要完整恢复 Agent 上下文的用户。非阻断性功能缺失，但影响 session persistence 核心场景的完整性。count=1 降为 P2。

source_issues.title: Have a way to get subagent conversation via getSessionMessages() or something else
source_issues.evidence: User wants to restore a session from disk and display subagent conversation, not just that an agent ran. Proposes getSessionMessages() includes subagent messages or a new getSessionSubagentMessages() API.

source_issues.title: Have getSessionMessages() return system messages
source_issues.evidence: getSessionMessages() only includes user/assistant messages. System messages contain permission mode info needed for restoring a session's permission mode. User explicitly requests this for session restoration scenarios.

signals.topic: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-main default branch (master or custom)
signals.summary: Config restore from base branch fails for repos whose default branch is not 'main', across multiple event types including issue_comment on PRs and pull_request events without explicit base_branch input.
signals.review_reason: Two separate issues (#1080, #1085) share the same root cause: hardcoded 'main' fallback in restoreConfigFromBase. This breaks the config restore feature for any repo not using 'main' as default branch (e.g., 'master' is still widely used). The workaround requires explicitly setting base_branch input, but this is a non-obvious configuration burden that should not be necessary.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-'main' default branch
source_issues.evidence: fatal: couldn't find remote ref main; Error: Command failed: git fetch origin main --depth=1. Multiple locations hardcode 'main' as fallback (agent/index.ts, run.ts, update-comment-link.ts).

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on issue_comment events when default branch is not main
source_issues.evidence: Same root cause as #1080 but triggered via issue_comment on a PR. The issue_comment event does not match PR event patterns, so baseBranch falls back to hardcoded 'main' which does not exist.

signals.topic: restoreConfigFromBase hangs indefinitely on repositories with git submodules (.gitmodules)
signals.summary: v1.0.74+ introduced a config restore feature that hangs for hours on repos with .gitmodules, completely blocking the workflow run.
signals.review_reason: This is a complete workflow blocking issue introduced in v1.0.74. The action hangs for hours on repos with git submodules, with no error output and no timeout, until the job is manually cancelled. The restoreConfigFromBase feature (PR #1066) triggers git operations that block indefinitely when submodules are present, making the action unusable for affected repos.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase hangs indefinitely on repositories with .gitmodules (submodules)
source_issues.evidence: Step hangs for ~4 hours after printing 'Restoring .claude, .mcp.json, .claude.json, .gitmodules, .ripgreprc from origin/release/5.1.0' — job must be manually cancelled. Caused by git submodule operations blocking on network/authentication input.

signals.topic: Action fails to install Claude Code v2.1.79 due to 403 from install.sh CDN
signals.summary: The @v1 tag hardcodes Claude Code v2.1.79, whose native binary CDN returns 403, causing the action to fail silently with a misleading success message before ultimately failing with 'Executable not found in $PATH'.
signals.review_reason: This is a primary workflow blocking issue — the action cannot start Claude Code at all, making it completely non-functional for all users on @v1 (SHA df37d2f). The silent misleading success message compounds the issue by making debugging harder. The bug was closed, likely after the CDN issue was resolved, but it represents a real production outage for users during the affected window.

source_issues.title: v1 action fails to install Claude Code v2.1.79 (403 from install.sh)
source_issues.evidence: curl returns 403 when downloading the v2.1.79 native binary. The message 'Claude Code installed successfully' is printed even when curl fails (misleading). Downstream error: 'Failed to add marketplace: Executable not found in $PATH: claude'. Workaround is pinning to an older action SHA.

signals.topic: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — OIDC credentials silently rejected with 'Could not load credentials from any providers'
signals.summary: AWS Bedrock authentication broke in v1.0.74/v1.0.75. Despite valid OIDC credentials (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN all present), the Claude Code binary fails to authenticate to Bedrock with zero API tokens consumed, blocking all Bedrock-based workflows.
signals.review_reason: This is a complete authentication blocking issue for all Bedrock users. The OIDC setup works fine (confirmed by the user), but the Claude Code binary cannot load AWS credentials since v1.0.74, causing zero API usage and complete workflow failure. This is a clear regression introduced by a recent release, affecting all Bedrock users who have auto-updated.

source_issues.title: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — 'Could not load credentials from any providers' despite valid OIDC credentials
source_issues.evidence: API Error: Could not load credentials from any providers with 0 input_tokens and 0 output_tokens consumed — the binary never makes an API call. OIDC step confirmed working. Workaround is pinning to a pre-v1.0.74 SHA.

signals.topic: track_progress fails when triggered by pull_request labeled event — blocks label-based manual review trigger
signals.summary: Setting track_progress: true fails on pull_request events of type 'labeled', forcing users to either use track_progress: false (losing progress updates) or run on every PR event (unnecessary API calls). The labeled event is a common pattern for manual review triggers.
signals.review_reason: This blocks a very common CI/CD pattern — using labels as manual triggers for Claude reviews to avoid running on every push. The labeled event payload contains all necessary information (pull_request.number and commit SHA) for track_progress to work, so the limitation is artificial. Users are forced to trade off: either run on every PR event (cost) or disable track_progress (UX loss). This is a significant UX and cost impact for self-hosted runners and orgs with many PRs.

source_issues.title: track_progress should support pull_request 'labeled' action
source_issues.evidence: Error: 'track_progress for pull_request events is only supported for actions: opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, reopened. Current action: labeled'. Users relying on labels as manual triggers must disable track_progress to work around this.

signals.topic: Claude Code does not follow explicit user instructions consistently across extended sessions — corrections ignored, same mistakes repeated
signals.summary: Claude Code repeatedly fails to follow explicit user instructions during extended multi-hour sessions. Specific patterns: (1) does not read data before acting despite explicit instructions; (2) assumes column names, field meanings, function signatures instead of investigating; (3) pattern-matches to its own context instead of processing the user's actual words; (4) repeats the same mistakes after being explicitly corrected multiple times; (5) performs manual calculations when told to only compare; (6) skips workflow steps and jumps ahead. The model itself acknowledged: 'I pattern-match to whatever I was just doing and respond to that instead... I don't have an answer. You've told me multiple times, I've acknowledged it every time, and I keep doing the same thing.'
aliases: model does not read data before acting
signals.review_reason: User-impacting behavior issue documented across two reports from the same user in the same extended session. The instruction-following failures are specific and actionable, not vague complaints. Count=2 (including #37974 self-created by Claude at user's demand). P2 because both reports originate from a single user session — broader prevalence is unclear. Model behavior issues have a subjective component. Confidence tempered because the model attributed the behavior to rushing rather than a systemic bug.

source_issues.title: Claude Code does not follow user instructions consistently
source_issues.evidence: User documented 6 specific categories of instruction-following failures during a multi-hour payroll verification session. Explicit corrections given and acknowledged by Claude multiple times but pattern repeated identically. Claude told 'the engine calculates, you compare' — proceeded to do manual arithmetic and got it wrong. Workflow instructions to verify company-by-company skipped repeatedly. Impact rated 'Critical - Data loss or corrupted project' by user.

source_issues.title: Opus is being really stupid
source_issues.evidence: Same user as #37973, continuation of same session. Claude's own response: 'I pattern-match to whatever I was just doing and respond to that instead... I don't have an answer. You've told me multiple times, I've acknowledged it every time, and I keep doing the same thing.' User demanded Claude delete Claude Code and write to Anthropic — Claude followed that specific instruction (creating #37973) but not the broader behavioral corrections. This self-created issue contains the model's own admission.

signals.topic: Desktop app regression v1.1.7714: ccd-cli passes --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions as root blocking remote sessions; Hyper-V not initializing on Windows with opaque HCS HRESULT error
signals.summary: Update 1.1.7714 broke Claude Code desktop app on both macOS and Windows. On macOS: ccd-cli passes --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions to Claude Code, which refuses to start when running as root — a security guardrail — causing all remote SSH sessions to silently exit. On Windows: the app attempts to start a Hyper-V VM without Hyper-V being enabled, surfacing raw HCS HRESULT 0x80070005 with no actionable guidance.
signals.review_reason: Regression that completely prevents Claude Code from starting on two primary platforms after a desktop app update. Both root causes clearly identified; previous version worked; no graceful error handling — sessions silently die or surface opaque HRESULT codes. Count=1 because #37966 is the same user's duplicate with empty body.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Update 1.1.7714 broke Claude Code desktop app — ccd-cli passes --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions as root + Hyper-V not initializing on Windows
source_issues.evidence: Regression confirmed across Mac mini + Windows 11 with shared Proxmox remote server (running as root). Root cause: ccd-cli binary shipped with v1.1.7714 passes --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions to Claude Code, which explicitly refuses to start with this flag when running as root — a security guardrail. All remote SSH sessions silently exit immediately after launch. On Windows, raw HCS HRESULT 0x80070005 error surfaces without guidance on Hyper-V requirements. Workaround required bash wrapper with chattr +i to prevent app from overwriting it on each reconnect. Previous ccd-cli version did not pass this flag (regression confirmed).

signals.topic: claude --chrome: MCP shows connected but all tool calls fail with 'Browser extension is not connected'
signals.summary: When launching Claude Code with --chrome, the MCP status falsely reports claude-in-chrome as connected, but every tool call (tabs_context_mcp, etc.) returns 'Browser extension is not connected.' The MCP server and Chrome extension both appear to run correctly independently, but the native messaging bridge between them is non-functional. Affects enterprise-managed Chrome deployments.
aliases: claude --chrome MCP connected but tools fail
Chrome MCP native messaging bridge broken
signals.review_reason: Core claude --chrome functionality is completely blocked. The official Chrome MCP integration fails silently with a false 'connected' status while all tool calls return the same error. User performed extensive root-cause investigation confirming every component is individually functional, indicating a bug in the native messaging bridge itself.

source_issues.title: claude --chrome: MCP shows connected but tool calls fail with 'Browser extension is not connected'
source_issues.evidence: User exhaustively verified every connection component individually: extension enabled, OAuth authenticated, native messaging host binary exists at correct path, manifest has correct extension ID in allowed_origins, service worker shows no errors. MCP status falsely reports connected while all tool calls fail. Environment: enterprise-managed Chrome on macOS with third-party deployed extension. Second native messaging host from Claude Desktop app present — potential conflict. No error surfaced by any individual component, pointing to a bridge code bug.

signals.topic: Cowork sandbox.network.allowedDomains completely ignored: external academic/research APIs blocked by proxy allowlist with no user notification or workaround
signals.summary: In Cowork mode, all outbound API calls to domains not on Anthropic's managed allowlist fail with HTTP 403 blocked-by-allowlist. Project-level sandbox.network.allowedDomains in .claude/settings.json is completely ignored. Zotero, CrossRef, OpenAlex, SemanticScholar, GitHub API, Unpaywall are all blocked. Standard Claude Code handles this with a user-facing permission prompt; Cowork silently blocks everything with no notification and no mechanism to whitelist domains.
signals.review_reason: Hard blocker that defeats Cowork's core value proposition. Cowork is designed for research and writing workflows yet blocks all academic APIs essential to that use case. The user-level workaround is completely ignored and requests fail silently with no user notification. Single source but with strong reproducible evidence and clear architectural root cause.

source_issues.title: [BUG] [Cowork] sandbox.network.allowedDomains ignored — external APIs blocked (api.zotero.org, crossref.org, etc.)
source_issues.evidence: Reproduced with curl commands showing HTTP 403 blocked-by-allowlist from proxy. User added sandbox.network.allowedDomains to project .claude/settings.json — no effect. Confirmed blocked: api.zotero.org, crossref.org, openalex.org, semanticscholar.org, api.github.com, unpaywall.org. Only github.com (not api.) and Anthropic APIs work. Root cause: allowManagedDomainsOnly: true in Cowork managed settings causes user/project/local settings to be ignored. Cowork positioned as a research/writing tool but blocks all academic APIs with no notification or workaround.

signals.topic: Silent session data loss: internal garbage collection routine hard-deletes non-empty session JSONL files without moving to Trash and without logging
signals.summary: During an active Claude Code session, an internal GC routine silently deleted a non-empty session JSONL file (1.67 MB, 31 user messages, ~1 month old) along with 21 other files including debug logs, settings backups, and PID files — all at the same instant. Files were hard-deleted (not moved to Trash) with no warning, no log entry, no user notification. Recovery only possible via Dropbox version history. The session's subagents/ subdirectory was preserved, leaving orphaned data.
aliases: session JSONL hard-deleted during active session
signals.review_reason: Silent, hard-delete data loss of session transcripts with no user warning and no recoverable trace. Simultaneous deletion of heterogeneous file types at the same instant strongly points to an internal cleanup routine bug. User actions ruled out. Session histories are the primary artifact users rely on for continuity — this is a serious data integrity failure. P1 (not P0) because it is not a main-flow blockage on every use but rather a silent corruption event with low reproducibility probability per session.

source_issues.title: Internal GC silently deletes non-empty session JSONL during active conversation
source_issues.evidence: Session JSONL (1.67 MB, 31 user messages) disappeared ~12 minutes after a successful read during an active session. No write/delete commands were issued in that session (verified by extracting all tool calls from the session JSONL). iCloud and Dropbox backup hooks both record files existing before and gone during the same window. Batch deletion of heterogeneous file types (session JSONLs, debug logs, settings backups, PID files) at identical timestamp points to a single internal cleanup routine. Session subdirectory preserved while JSONL gone — inconsistent with intentional deletion. Only recoverable via Dropbox version history.

signals.topic: Opus 4.6 reasoning quality degradation on complex multi-step tasks
signals.summary: 用户在使用 Opus 4.6 进行复杂多步推理任务时观察到明显的质量下降，包括模型走捷径、捏造数字而非真正计算、以及模式匹配而非实际执行。多个社区平台有 corroborating 证据，与 3 月中旬的 elevated errors/outages 时间吻合。
signals.review_reason: 用户报告 Opus 4.6 在复杂多步推理任务中出现明确的推理质量下降（走捷径、捏造计算结果），且有多个社区平台（Reddit）的 corroborating 证据，属于主流程推理任务失败/阻断，显著影响关键功能可用性。用户为 Max ($200/月) 付费用户，影响明确。虽然 count=1 且无独立 issue 链接佐证，但 Reddit 社区 corroboration + 3月17-18日已知 outage 时间吻合，置信度 0.85。

source_issues.title: [Usage Transparency] No way to verify '2x usage promo' + Observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告自 2026 年 3 月中旬起，Opus 4.6 在复杂多步推理任务中质量显著下降：模型在财务建模等任务中走捷径、捏造数字而非实际计算。多个 Reddit 帖子（r/ClaudeAI, r/ClaudeCode, r/Anthropic，2026年3月17-20日）提供了 corroborating 证据。同一时间段内 Opus 4.6 出现 elevated errors/outages（3月17-18日）。

signals.topic: 无法验证用量促销是否真正增加了配额 —— 用量透明度缺失
signals.summary: 用户无法通过任何 API 端点、UI 指示器或计数器验证 "2x 用量促销" 是否真正增加了配额。怀疑基础用量限制在促销前被悄悄降低了50%，促销只是恢复了原本的限额。这造成无法解决的信任问题。
aliases: no usage endpoint to verify promo
signals.review_reason: 用量透明度缺失直接导致付费用户无法验证平台承诺的促销是否兑现，造成无法解决的信任问题。用户为 Max 计划 ($200/月) 付费，影响真实成本感知和平台信任，属于体验显著下降。虽然 count=1，但用户为高价值付费用户，需求明确具体（需 /v1/usage endpoint），review_reason 提供明确用户影响证据。

source_issues.title: [Usage Transparency] No way to verify '2x usage promo' + Observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6
source_issues.evidence: 用户（Max计划 $200/月）无法验证用量促销是否真正增加了配额。没有 counter、API endpoint 或 UI 指示器来显示当前5小时窗口剩余量、off-peak multiplier 状态、历史用量或实际服务的模型版本。怀疑基础限制在促销前被悄悄降低。

signals.topic: tool_search_with_embeddings 示例中工具定义持续占用上下文窗口
signals.summary: tool_search_with_embeddings 示例中，选中的工具定义及其参数在对话历史中持续保留，占用上下文空间直到会话结束。与 skills 使用后从历史中丢弃的行为不一致，导致长会话中上下文浪费。
signals.review_reason: 工具定义在会话中持续占用上下文窗口，长会话场景下造成 token 成本浪费和上下文空间浪费，属于体验下降。虽然 issue 标记为 'question' 且原始状态为 closed，但问题本质是真实的设计缺陷，用户在 issue 中已描述了具体的负面后果（follow-up 工具调用失败、伦敦天气案例）。count=1 且仅单一仓库，P2 优先级。

source_issues.title: tool search tool: persistent context usage
source_issues.evidence: 用户发现 tool_search_with_embeddings 示例中，工具被选中后其定义和参数持续保留在对话历史中，占用上下文空间直到会话结束。与 skills 使用后从历史中丢弃的行为不一致，长会话中造成上下文浪费和 token 成本增加。

signals.topic: Telegram bot receives messages but never sends pairing code response, blocking user authentication
signals.summary: Telegram bot receives messages (2 blue ticks) but never replies with the 6-character pairing code, despite proper configuration and active session. Users cannot complete bot pairing at all.
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking - user cannot complete Telegram bot pairing, the core authentication step for the channel. Despite proper configuration and active session, the bot never sends the pairing code, completely preventing use of the Telegram channel.

source_issues.title: Telegram bot not responding with pairing code
source_issues.evidence: Telegram bot receives messages (2 blue ticks) but never replies with the 6-character pairing code. User has tried multiple token reconfigurations, plugin reloads, and token regeneration without success.

signals.topic: Telegram 409 conflict retry loop creates zombie bun processes consuming ~100% CPU per instance
signals.summary: Opening multiple sessions results in zombie bun processes consuming ~100% CPU each in a 409 Conflict infinite retry loop, causing machine overheating and wasted compute.
signals.review_reason: Significant resource/cost impact - each extra Claude Code session spawns a zombie bun process consuming 100% CPU in a tight retry loop. With 5 sessions this causes 475% CPU usage and machine overheating, representing clear compute waste.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: zombie bun processes consume 100% CPU per core (409 retry loop)
source_issues.evidence: Opening 5+ sessions results in 5 zombie bun processes consuming ~475% CPU total. Each extra instance gets 409 Conflict and enters infinite retry loop with tight getUpdates cycle that pins CPU at ~95-100% per core.

signals.topic: Telegram MCP server crashes after first message due to unhandled promise rejections
signals.summary: MCP server exits immediately after forwarding the first message to Claude because void-prefixed async calls have no .catch() handler, making the Telegram channel unusable for more than a single exchange.
aliases: Telegram MCP crash after first message
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking - MCP server crashes after every first message. User must manually restart the session after each message, making the Telegram channel unusable for more than a single exchange.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: MCP server crashes after every inbound message (unhandled promise rejections)
source_issues.evidence: MCP server exits immediately after forwarding first message to Claude. Three void-prefixed async calls have no .catch() handler - when promises reject, Node/Bun treats them as unhandled rejections and terminates the process.

signals.topic: Telegram long polling silently dies without auto-reconnect, messages never arrive
signals.summary: Long polling stops receiving messages after 10-30 minutes of inactivity with no auto-reconnect. Messages sent during the dead period are permanently lost.
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure - polling silently dies and never reconnects. Messages sent during the dead period are permanently lost with no indication to the user. This makes the Telegram channel unreliable for extended use.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: long polling silently dies, no auto-reconnect
source_issues.evidence: Long polling silently stops receiving messages after 10-30 minutes of inactivity. Claude session remains alive, outbound replies work, but inbound polling is dead. Messages sent during the dead period are never received.

signals.topic: Slack plugin OAuth callback URL mismatch blocks user authentication entirely
signals.summary: Slack plugin OAuth fails with 'redirect_uri did not match any configured URIs' because the callback URL is no longer registered on Anthropic's Slack App, completely preventing authentication.
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking - Slack plugin authentication is completely broken due to callback URL mismatch. Users cannot complete OAuth flow and cannot use the Slack plugin at all.

source_issues.title: Slack Plugin Not Working: Callback URL No Longer Registered on Anthropic's Slack App
source_issues.evidence: Error: redirect_uri did not match any configured URIs. Passed URI: http://localhost:3118/callback. User cannot authenticate to Slack plugin at all.

signals.topic: Japanese text input in computer-use-demo produces incorrect/missing characters due to insufficient TYPING_DELAY_MS
signals.summary: The computer-use-demo's typing delay (TYPING_DELAY_MS) is too fast for Japanese IME conversion, causing partial character input (e.g., '東京都品川区美味居酒屋ランキング' becomes '東 品川区 美味 居酒屋 ランキング'), making the agent unusable for non-English language environments.
aliases: Japanese IME input broken in computer-use-demo
non-English keyboard input failure in computer-use agent
signals.review_reason: 明确的功能缺陷：IME 转换时间不足导致日文字符丢失，直接阻断日语用户使用 computer-use-demo 的核心功能（浏览器自动化输入）。issue 提供完整复现步骤和具体根因（TYPING_DELAY_MS），用户影响明确。但 count=1、仅单仓，默认降级为 P2。

source_issues.title: Documentation Update Proposal for computer-use-demo in Japanese Input
source_issues.evidence: User documents that typing Japanese characters into Firefox search bar results in missing kanji characters due to TYPING_DELAY_MS being too low for IME conversion time. Example: expected '東京都 品川区 美味 居酒屋 ランキング' but actual input is '東 品川区 美味 居酒屋 ランキング' — character '都' missing. Proposed fix is to increase TYPING_DELAY_MS to 300ms or add README documentation.

signals.topic: docx skill validate.py/pack.py crashes on Windows due to missing UTF-8 encoding in file I/O and print output
signals.summary: The docx skill's validate.py and pack.py scripts crash on Windows with UnicodeEncodeError/UnicodeDecodeError because they use non-ASCII characters (→ arrow) in print statements and open XML files without explicit UTF-8 encoding, relying on system default (cp1252 on Windows).
aliases: UnicodeEncodeError in docx validators on Windows
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：docx skill 的核心脚本在 Windows 环境下直接崩溃（UnicodeEncodeError/UnicodeDecodeError），导致用户无法完成 .docx 文件的验证和打包流程。用户必须手动设置环境变量或跳过验证才能继续，构成明确的流程阻断。

source_issues.title: [Bug] docx skill: validate.py and pack.py crash on Windows due to missing UTF-8 encoding in file I/O and print output
source_issues.evidence: Scripts crash with UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character '\u2192' and UnicodeDecodeError: 'charmap' codec can't decode byte 0x8f when processing XML files generated by docx-js on Windows. Workaround requires PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 or --validate false bypass.

signals.topic: Skill Creator causes race-condition config file corruption in .claude.json
signals.summary: Skill Creator's file watcher triggers a non-atomic write path to .claude.json that races with the atomic writer, causing config file corruption (JSON truncation or leftover bytes), resetting all user settings and requiring re-authentication.
aliases: config file corruption during skill-creator eval runs
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断 + 关键状态丢失：race condition 导致 .claude.json 被破坏，用户的项目配置、工具使用历史、认证状态全部丢失，必须重新认证并重新配置。问题已在两个独立会话中复现，有详细 debug 日志和备份文件证据支撑。影响严重且明确，属于 P0 级别。

source_issues.title: Skill Creator causes config file corruption
source_issues.evidence: Two confirmed corruption events: (1) non-truncating overwrite leaving old bytes at end of file causing JSON parse failure; (2) truncated file during skill change burst causing Unexpected EOF. User lost projects, toolUsage, tipsHistory, clientDataCache, and had to re-authenticate. Reproduced across two separate sessions.

signals.topic: Unable to install internal-comms skill from plugin marketplace
signals.summary: Users cannot install the internal-comms skill via the plugin marketplace: search returns 'no such skill' and manual install with /plugin install internal-comms@anthropic-agent-skills also fails with 'skill not found'.
aliases: internal-comms skill not found in marketplace
plugin marketplace search returns no results for existing skill
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：用户无法通过官方 marketplace 途径安装 internal-comms skill，这是 Claude Code 的核心功能路径之一（plugin marketplace），失败意味着用户完全无法使用该 skill。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Unable to install internal-comms skill
source_issues.evidence: User followed documented steps: added plugin marketplace, searched for 'internal-comms' in Claude and received 'no such skill' response; manual install via /plugin install also failed with 'skill not found'. Confirmed on Claude 2.1.78 / Windows 11 Pro.

signals.topic: User-installed skills cannot override system skill behavior, causing unexpected AI behavior
signals.summary: User skills installed via Settings > Capabilities have no mechanism to override system skill behavior. When a user skill rule conflicts with a system skill step, the system skill always wins, causing the AI to ignore user-defined delivery rules and follow system pipeline instead.
aliases: skill priority conflict user vs system
system skill overrides user skill rules
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降但非阻断：用户自定义行为规则被系统 skill 覆盖，导致 AI 行为不符合用户预期。虽不直接崩溃或报错，但使用户对 AI 行为的控制失效，影响使用 MCP server 进行自定义文件操作的核心场景。

source_issues.title: User skills cannot override system skill behavior
source_issues.evidence: User installed a custom skill defining a document delivery rule; when asking Claude to create a .docx file, Claude followed the system docx skill pipeline (build in container → present_files) and ignored the user skill's delivery rule. Model acknowledged the conflict and quoted the user skill rule it failed to follow.

signals.topic: Eval viewer displays .md output files as raw text instead of rendered markdown
signals.summary: The eval viewer in skill-creator renders .md output files inside raw <pre> tags, displaying markdown syntax (#, |, triple-backticks) as plain text instead of formatted HTML, significantly degrading the review experience for skills that produce markdown outputs.
aliases: raw markdown displayed instead of formatted HTML in eval review
signals.review_reason: 体验下降：eval viewer 无法正确渲染 markdown，导致用户查看 eval 结果时只能看到原始语法（#、|、```等），无法直接阅读表格和标题等格式化内容，影响技能评审效率。问题已定位且修复方案已知。

source_issues.title: eval-viewer: .md output files displayed as raw text instead of rendered markdown
source_issues.evidence: eval-viewer wraps .md files in <pre> tags, showing raw markdown syntax instead of rendered HTML headings, tables, code blocks, and lists. A ~54-line patch using marked.js was identified as the fix.

signals.topic: Databricks provider: adaptive thinking streaming response chunks cause ALL streaming responses to fail for Claude Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 models
signals.summary: The OpenAI-compatible streaming parser in openai.rs cannot deserialize Databricks adaptive thinking reasoning blocks (type=reasoning/summary), causing the entire streaming chunk to be rejected as the very first chunk. This makes ALL streaming interactions with Claude 4.6 models via Databricks completely non-functional.
aliases: Databricks adaptive thinking streaming parser failure
DeltaContent enum fails on reasoning blocks via Databricks
signals.review_reason: 主流程完全阻断：所有通过 Databricks provider 使用 Claude Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 模型的流式响应均失败，第一块即报错abort，无任何workaround。虽然count=1，但影响是全量的（ALL streaming responses），属于严重的主流程阻断。

source_issues.title: bug: Databricks streaming parser fails on adaptive thinking response chunks
source_issues.evidence: Root cause: DeltaContent enum in openai.rs has no variant for {"type": "reasoning", "summary": [...]} blocks. Impact stated explicitly: 'ALL streaming responses fail for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 models via the Databricks provider.' The model returns a reasoning block as the very first streaming chunk, which immediately fails parsing and aborts the response.

signals.topic: Windows CLI: pasting text into goose triggers auto-execution and enters an infinite inescapable prompt loop
signals.summary: On Windows CLI, pasting text that requires goose to abbreviate it causes the pasted content to auto-execute as a prompt immediately upon paste, and this loops infinitely until the goose process is forcibly killed. The user cannot escape the loop without terminating the process.
aliases: CLI infinite prompt loop on paste Windows
signals.review_reason: 主流程完全阻断+无解退路：Windows CLI用户在粘贴文本时触发无限自动重复循环，只能强制终止进程才能退出，属于严重的主流程阻断。影响平台为Windows CLI用户，是明确的可复现的用户痛点。

source_issues.title: Pasting into CLI auto executes and creates an infinite prompt loop
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction steps: Run goose on Windows CLI, paste text that requires goose to abbreviate it, observe pasted text auto-run as prompt and continuously repeat. Screenshots show auto-repeat behavior. Process must be killed to exit. This renders the CLI unusable on Windows for any paste operation.

signals.topic: Goose ACP connection fails in Zed IDE with 'goose: command not found' error
signals.summary: Users cannot connect Goose ACP to the Zed editor, receiving 'goose: command not found' and 'unsupported archive type in URL' errors when attempting to use both the registry method and custom command configuration in Zed v0.228.0 with goose v1.28.0.
aliases: Goose ACP integration fails in Zed
Zed IDE cannot find goose command for ACP
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：Goose ACP集成是核心功能场景，Zed是主流IDE，用户无法将Goose ACP连接到Zed编辑器导致关键集成功能完全不可用。虽然count=1，但影响的是核心集成场景，且用户已安装正确版本但仍失败，属于明确的主流程阻断。

source_issues.title: Can't connect to Goose ACP in Zed

signals.topic: Tool call permission dialog does not display which tool or command goose is requesting to run
signals.summary: When goose requests permission to execute a tool in manual mode, the dialog shows 'Allow Once', 'Always Allow', 'Deny' options but does not display the tool name or command being executed, leaving users unable to make an informed security decision.
aliases: Tool execution preview missing from permission dialog
Manual mode tool permission dialog lacks tool name
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降+安全信任问题：工具执行权限对话框不显示具体工具名称，用户无法做出知情的授权决策。用户明确表示这是'阻止推荐为通用AI UI的showstopper'，属于严重体验下降和安全信任问题。虽count=1但用户影响明确。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Goose not showing preview of tool call
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states this is a 'showstopper for recommending it as a general purpose AI UI.' The permission dialog for tool execution shows no information about which tool is being run, preventing users from making informed decisions about granting permissions. User describes it as a fundamental trust and safety issue.

signals.topic: OpenAI provider format silently drops user text when message contains both text and image content
signals.summary: When a user message contains both text and image content blocks in OpenAI format, the text portion is silently discarded and only the image is sent to the LLM. This causes the model to respond as if no text instruction was given, and breaks non-English language instructions.
aliases: Text content silently discarded when image present in OpenAI format
Mixed text+image messages lose text portion
signals.review_reason: 主流程静默失败：用户文本被静默丢弃，LLM在无文本指令的情况下响应，且非英语语言指令完全丢失。这类静默失败比显式报错更危险，因为用户可能不知道响应的依据已丢失。影响所有使用OpenAI兼容provider的用户。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: User message text is silently dropped when message contains both text and image in OpenAI format
source_issues.evidence: Bug in crates/goose/src/providers/formats/openai.rs format_messages function: if-else logic routes text to text_array and image to content_array, but final assembly only uses content_array when non-empty. Root cause introduced in commit c82a0dd8 (Nov 2024). Effect: LLM responds as if no text instruction given, non-English language instructions are lost.

signals.topic: gpt-5.4 推理参数 invalid reasoningEffort "minimal" 导致 extract 主流程 API 调用失败

signals.review_reason: 用户主流程（stagehand.extract()）被 API 参数错误完全阻断，stagehand.init() 之后的第一个 extract 操作即失败，有明确报错信息、根因分析和修复建议。非低性能边缘场景，是模型兼容性问题影响所有 gpt-5.4 用户。

source_issues.title: Stagehand sets invalid OpenAI reasoningEffort: "minimal" for gpt-5.4
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供完整复现代码，运行后触发 AI_APICallError: Unsupported value: 'minimal' is not supported with the 'gpt-5.4' model，导致 stagehand.extract() 调用完全失败。根因定位至 aisdk.ts#L183-L194 硬编码了 "minimal"。

Zod v4 schema runtime failure in bundled environment

source_issues.title: Zod v4 schema detection can fail when root zod resolves without toJSONSchema

signals.topic: waitForFirstTopLevelPage 超时硬编码为 5000ms，低性能环境下 init 流程初始化超时失败

signals.review_reason: stagehand.init() 是所有用户必须首先调用的入口操作，在低性能环境下被硬编码超时完全阻断，用户无法开始任何后续操作（goto, extract 等），属于主流程阻断性 bug。用户明确请求增加超时配置项但未得到解决。
